clue.text: Felicity initially lacking flexibility

indicators.note: the synonym for felicity loses its opening letter, the one at the start

parts.note: felicity is happiness, which is blitheness

explanation.surface: Someone who has lost their good cheer seems to have lost their suppleness too.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially lacking' drops the B from BLITHENESS.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: being lithe means being supple and bending easily, so the noun is suppleness.

clue.text: Praise ace racing driver

parts.note: A is the abbreviation for ace in cards

explanation.surface: Applauding a brilliant racing driver.
explanation.walkthrough: Niki Lauda was an Austrian Formula One world champion.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Niki Lauda won three Formula One world championships.

clue.text: Business belonging to us is protected by trademark in America

indicators.note: the pieces sit inside the trademark symbol, guarded by it

parts.note: TM is the US trademark symbol

explanation.surface: A company of ours is covered by an American trademark.
explanation.definitionFit: Category: tourism is an industry, the business of serving travellers.

clue.text: Just finished going round New Haven

indicators.note: the word for finished goes round the rearranged letters
new means made over, so the letters are put in a fresh order

explanation.surface: A journey just completed by circling New Haven.
explanation.walkthrough: New Haven is a city in Connecticut, but 'New' signals rearranging HAVEN as VENHA.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a just ruling is fair and impartial, treating all sides equally.

clue.text: Remove it from bathroom, then proceed

indicators.note: take the letters of it out
the word they are taken out of follows

parts.note: an ensuite is a bathroom attached to a bedroom

explanation.surface: An instruction: take it out of the bathroom, then carry on.
explanation.walkthrough: An ensuite, common in British homes and hotels, is a private bathroom off a bedroom.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to ensue is to follow on or result, to come next.

clue.text: Impious act of plunder endlessly upset revolutionary say

indicators.note: the word for plunder loses its final letter

parts.note: to sack a town is to plunder it

indicators.note: turning round, so the abbreviation is read upward

explanation.surface: A sacrilegious robbery, seemingly by a disgruntled rebel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' cuts SACK to SAC; 'revolutionary' turns EG to GE.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: sacrilege is the violation of something sacred, an irreverent act.

clue.text: Star of French New Wave's last book

indicators.note: the final letter of the word wave is taken

explanation.surface: A star of the French New Wave cinema movement and their final book.
explanation.walkthrough: The French New Wave was a cinema movement, but here 'New' only gives N and 'Wave's last' gives E.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Deneb is the brightest star in the constellation Cygnus.

clue.text: Cases of listeria had raised pulse

indicators.note: lifted up, so in a down clue the letters read upward
the outer letters of each word, like a case around its contents

explanation.surface: Cases of listeria caused raised heart rates.
explanation.walkthrough: The outer letters give L, A, H, D, and 'raised' turns them into DHAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: dhal is a lentil dish, and lentils are pulses, the edible seeds of legumes.

clue.text: Return of bees at first unnerves leading novelist

indicators.note: the adjective is turned back, read upward in this down clue
the opening letters of the two words that follow

explanation.surface: A swarm of bees comes back and unsettles a leading writer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Return' turns APIAN into NAIPA; 'at first' gives U and L.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: V. S. Naipaul was a Trinidad-born Nobel laureate writer of fiction.

clue.text: Sweets unsettle Sue's belly

indicators.note: letters that are unsettled are disturbed and rearranged

explanation.surface: Sweets give Sue an upset stomach.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: bullseyes are hard round peppermint sweets, traditional in Britain, striped black and white.

clue.text: Uncle Sam welcomes more reliable loan sharks

indicators.note: the abbreviation for the country takes the comparative in, holding it inside

parts.note: Uncle Sam personifies the United States, US

explanation.surface: America lets in predatory lenders who seem a safer bet.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: usurers lend money at extortionate interest, as loan sharks do.

clue.text: Break nail on inverted curve of skull

indicators.note: one piece placed on, that is next to, the other
the word for a curve is turned upside down, which in an across clue means read backwards
breaking the word nail scatters its letters into a new order

explanation.surface: A manicure mishap: a nail broken on an upturned curve.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inverted' turns ARC into CRA; 'Break' rearranges NAIL as NIAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: cranial is the adjective for the cranium, the skull.

clue.text: I teach trim jockeys some maths

indicators.note: to jockey is to manoeuvre and jostle, so the letters are moved about

explanation.surface: A teacher claims to instruct slim racing riders in a bit of mathematics.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jockeys' is a verb here, rearranging I TEACH TRIM.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: arithmetic, working with numbers, is one branch of mathematics.

clue.text: Singer found in conversation

indicators.note: in spoken conversation the word is heard rather than seen, so it is a soundalike

parts.note: to found a theory on something is to base it there

explanation.surface: A vocalist discovered while chatting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'found' is not the past of find but the verb meaning establish, BASE, which is said the same as BASS.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a bass is a male singer with the lowest voice range.

clue.text: Chinese scholar alone grasps mind's interior essence

indicators.note: the word for alone holds the letters inside it
the inner letters of the word mind

explanation.surface: A lone academic grasps the core of the Chinese mind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'interior' takes IN from MIND, which SOLO surrounds.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: a sinologist studies China's language, history and culture.

clue.text: Withdraw personnel from Kurt Waldheim?

definitions.meaning: to take away the crew or staff from a ship or post
Kurt Waldheim was UN Secretary-General, so a United Nations man; the question mark flags a definition by example

explanation.surface: Taking staff away from a former UN chief.
explanation.walkthrough: Kurt Waldheim, an Austrian, led the United Nations from 1972 to 1981.
explanation.definitionFit: Verb sense: to remove the crew from a vessel or post; read in two parts it also describes a United Nations official.

clue.text: Something that stimulates action in capital

parts.note: an upper is a stimulant drug
a case is a legal action, a lawsuit

explanation.surface: A spur to activity in the capital city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' means a capital letter, not a city.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: capital letters and uppercase letters are the same thing.

clue.text: Retired contractor missing bachelor friend in particular

indicators.note: retired means withdrawn or gone back, so the shortened muscle is read backwards
the muscle is missing the letter for bachelor

parts.note: the biceps is a muscle, something that contracts

explanation.surface: A retired builder has lost a bachelor friend in particular.
explanation.walkthrough: A contractor is not a builder but a muscle, the BICEPS; 'missing' removes B to give ICEPS, and 'Retired' turns it into SPECI.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: specially and in particular both mean for one purpose or person above others.

clue.text: Quick to notice dog without tail regularly yields

indicators.note: the dog breed loses its last letter

parts.note: a shar-pei is a wrinkly Chinese dog breed

indicators.note: every other letter of the word yields, taken at regular intervals

explanation.surface: A watchful dog with no tail gives way at regular intervals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without tail' drops I from SHARPEI; 'regularly' takes Y, E, D from 'yields'.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: sharp-eyed means observant, with keen sight.

clue.text: Songwriter with mature bearing

indicators.note: one piece placed alongside the other

parts.note: Cole Porter was an American songwriter

explanation.surface: A songwriter whose bearing has grown with maturity.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: porterage is the carrying of loads, that is bearing them.

clue.text: Return from Europe not at all uplifted

indicators.note: lifted up, so in this down clue the letters are read upward

explanation.surface: Returning from Europe without any lift in mood.
explanation.walkthrough: EU NEVER is read upward.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: revenue is income, the return on an investment or business.

clue.text: Watering hole of Aussies scrubbed periodically

indicators.note: every second letter of these words is scrubbed out at regular intervals, leaving the alternate ones

explanation.surface: A drinking spot for Australians that gets cleaned now and then.
explanation.walkthrough: The pick runs across two words: O, A, S, I, S from 'of Aussies'.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an oasis is a fertile spot with water in a desert, a literal watering hole.

clue.text: It's not a foreign channel

indicators.note: foreign means strange or alien, so the letters are made strange by rearranging

explanation.surface: A statement that a TV channel is a domestic one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'foreign' looks like part of the channel's description but rearranges IT'S NOT A.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a TV or radio station is a broadcasting channel.

clue.text: Rapturous state, moving right to the front

indicators.note: a letter in the word for state is shifted to a new position
the letter goes to the start of the word

explanation.surface: A blissful mood when someone moves to the right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moving right to the front' takes the R of AVER and puts it first.
explanation.definitionFit: Usage: a rave review is an ecstatic, wildly enthusiastic one.

clue.text: See head of state wearing majestic old crown

indicators.note: the word for majestic has the single letter put on inside it, worn like clothing
the first letter of the word state

parts.note: the pate is the crown of the head

explanation.surface: A head of state wearing a grand antique crown.
explanation.walkthrough: 'See' is the noun: a bishop's diocese.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a see is a bishop's office or jurisdiction, which is the bishopric or episcopate.

clue.text: Dumpy individual succeeded by virtue of being British

parts.note: S is a genealogical abbreviation for succeeded
qua is Latin for in the capacity of

explanation.surface: A stout person succeeded simply by being British.
explanation.definitionFit: Dictionary sense: a squab is a short, fat person, also a young pigeon.

clue.text: Ontario neighbour keeping Japanese currency in inaccessible place

indicators.note: the lake keeps the letter inside it

parts.note: Lake Erie neighbours Lake Ontario and borders the province
Y is the symbol for yen

explanation.surface: A neighbour of Ontario hiding yen somewhere hard to reach.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: an eyrie is an eagle's nest high on a cliff, so any remote lofty spot.

clue.text: Wife shuns fine game

indicators.note: the letter for wife avoids the word, leaving it

explanation.surface: A wife avoids a good game.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: I-spy is a guessing game played by children, often on car journeys.

clue.text: Pardon daughters ejected from accursed, filthy place

indicators.note: the two letters are thrown out of the word for accursed

parts.note: D is the abbreviation for daughter, so two of them
a sty is a filthy place, like a pigsty

explanation.surface: A father pleads forgiveness for daughters thrown out of a cursed, squalid home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ejected from' removes both Ds of DAMNED, leaving AMNE.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an amnesty is an official pardon granted to offenders.

clue.text: It makes one wing of chateau timelessly smarter

indicators.note: a wing is an end of a building, here the last letter of the word chateau
the letter for time is taken out

explanation.surface: A sleek new wing makes a chateau look smarter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'timelessly' drops T (time) from NIFTIER.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: something that unites things makes them one.

clue.text: Disheartened drunk chasing last of the hard stuff

indicators.note: the shortened drunk word follows behind, chasing the single letter
the final letter of the word the
the heart, the middle letter, is removed

explanation.surface: A miserable drunk goes after the last of the whisky.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the hard stuff' usually means strong drink; here it describes the abrasive.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: emery is a very hard mineral used as an abrasive, as on emery boards.

clue.text: Girl coming out of westbound Underground pinched by poet

indicators.note: held tight inside the poet's name
travelling west, right to left in an across clue, means read backwards

parts.note: the Tube is London's Underground railway

explanation.surface: A girl is pickpocketed by a poet as she leaves a westbound train.
explanation.walkthrough: 'westbound' reverses TUBE to EBUT.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: a debutante is a young woman making her formal entry, or coming out, into society.
